newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine's Kuchma sacks agriculture minister.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine's Kuchma sacks agriculture minister.

text.p: Ukrainian President Leonid Kuchma has sacked Agriculture Minister Anatoly Khorishko but no replacement has been named yet, a press spokesman for Kuchma said on Monday.
"We are still waiting for an official signed order and the name of the new minister," the press spokesman said.
He said Kuchma had referred to "serious inadequacies" in the ministry's work when he announced the decision at a meeting with his prime minister and other government officials late on Friday.
Kuchma has referred to a need for big changes in his cabinet several times this year.
Khorishko was appointed last summer in the aftermath of a drought which was blamed for a record low grain crop of 25.4 million tonnes against 36.5 million tonnes in 1995.
Ukraine regularly produced grain crops of up to 50 million tonnes in Soviet times.
